source: Fleeting weekly discovery crawl whole board (board_source.py / board.json rule)
activation_note: INERT until LAS-160 approves a reservation program. Links render plain with first-party UTM (utm_campaign=EXP-0103); no affiliate id is applied while every network in affiliate_config.json is disabled with a placeholder id. Flipping a network enabled=true with a real id there (or via its env var) activates the affiliate wrap on this rail with no code change. Caveat: an Eventbrite listing that already carries its own aff= search tag will not be overridden by our Eventbrite id (affiliate._add_params never clobbers an existing param); resolving that is an LAS-160 activation decision.
methodology: A window is listed only when its own crawl-captured link (booking_url, else source_url) lands on a recognised reservation/ticket platform, the crawl verified it (not needs_confirm), and it carries a real parseable close date that has not passed. No dead or invented links; an empty week is honest. Sorted soonest-closing first.

items.title: Nashville Holiday Harvest Food & Vendor Festival
items.blurb: A food and vendor festival in the park, timed for early holiday shopping and snacking. Sales are flagged as ending soon, so grab tickets ahead.

items.title: Ice Cream Cocktail Mixology Class
items.blurb: A midday mixology class where the ice cream goes in the glass. Sales are flagged as ending soon.

items.title: Fixin's Fest featuring The Cornbread Cook Off
items.blurb: Side dishes from favorite local eateries gather under one roof for the first Fixin's Fest and Cornbread Cook Off. Grab a plate, rank your favorites, then line dance. Noon to 4pm, no refunds.

items.title: Handmade Pasta Making Class with Chef Taylor
items.venue: Mary Louise's Social Club at Tempo by Hilton Nashville Downtown
items.blurb: A hands-on pasta class led by Chef Taylor at a downtown hotel venue. You make the pasta yourself, and a second date is on offer if this one fills.

items.title: Nonna Notti Wine Dinner
items.blurb: A one-night wine dinner at an Italian market and deli. Pairing a deli counter with a wine list is a sound plan for a Friday.

items.title: Tipsy Turkey Pub Crawl
items.blurb: An afternoon pub crawl through Printers Alley with a Thanksgiving theme. Starting at 2:30 means you can be home before the real turkey conversation.

items.title: The Pasta Club: Gnocchi Night
items.blurb: A Monday late-afternoon gnocchi session, one night only. The ticket page already says almost full.

items.title: 100 Cities Project: Nashville Dinner Benefiting The Water Project
items.blurb: A benefit dinner for The Water Project at a host restaurant the listing names only as Restaurant of the Week. Two additional dates are listed.

items.title: A Starlit Dinner Amongst The Stars
items.blurb: A ticketed dinner set at the Parthenon, which is a rarer dining room than most in town. One evening only.

items.title: RE:MIX #4 Presented by Soundtrack My Drink
items.blurb: The fourth installment of a drinks-meet-music series from Soundtrack My Drink, staged at a cocktail bar. Entry number four suggests the earlier ones went fine.
